watch.summary: A creator plays back his attempt at an inspirational team timeout speech, tries a second take to fix it, and laughs when his second attempt ends up even worse.

beats.what: The creator stumbles through an inspirational speech during a timeout.
He hits his punchy line, 'I'll never lose my belief.'
He laughs, realizing the speech failed to land.
He attempts a second take of the speech to redeem himself.
He cracks up, admitting the second try was even worse.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Nah it was even worse this second time around
watch.why: The humor comes from the self-own of trying to sound like a movie hero and failing twice. The second attempt being worse than the first creates a great anti-climax.
